Maria (Docs): ok team — creating a short PR to add a cost/latency breakdown example and an updated tracing-hook snippet for Console observability. I pushed branch `docs/obs-console-cost-snippet` and left a TODO for the v1->v2 dashboard migration notes.
Raj (Eng-Platform): thanks. can you include the SDK snippet for batching + cost tags? that was the blocker in the last merge.
Maria (Docs): yep, planning to add both JS and Python snippets. JS will call `redwood.client.trace()` wrapper and attach `x-cost-tier` metadata.
Olivia (Console): heads-up: the dashboard v2 renames the `cost_breakdown` table to `billing_items`. migration note must show the mapping and an example query.
Maria (Docs): good catch — i'll add a clear migration table. will paste sample SQL and the new dashboard widget json.
Dave (Eng-ML): for tracing hook: the new runtime sends `trace.parent_id` as hex; previous examples used int. make sure snippets use `hexlify` or string fmt.
Lina (DevEx): also update the SDK quickstart in the snippets page — we had an outdated `ClientConfig` field. small change but confuses users.
Maria (Docs): draft snippet I have for JS: ```js
// attach cost tag + start trace
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
client.startTrace({ name: 'generate', metadata: { cost_tier: 'interactive' } });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-rt-1', prompt });
```
Raj (Eng-Platform): looks good, add `latency_ms` metric emission example too, e.g. `emitMetric('inference.latency', latencyMs, {model: 'redwood-rt-1'})` so Console can show percentile breakdown.
Maria (Docs): adding that. also linking to the Console metric naming conventions doc.
Olivia (Console): for the dashboard widget json, include the new `group_by` for `route` and `model_version` — otherwise charts will be misleading after migration.
Maria (Docs): will do. quick Q: who can review the SQL mapping table? want Eng-Platform + Console signoff before I open PR.
Raj (Eng-Platform): I can review late today.
Olivia (Console): I can take it tomorrow AM.
Dave (Eng-ML): i'll sanity-check trace example and the hex vs int note.
Lina (DevEx): i'll run the snippets through the docs snippet linter and fix any formatting oddities.
Maria (Docs): sweet. plan: open PR by EOD, assign @Raj and @Olivia, mark it as `docs:obs` and include `migration:dashboard-v2` label. any blockers?
Raj (Eng-Platform): none from infra side. just ensure CI snippet tests pass.
Olivia (Console): none. remind me in the PR to check the widget render on staging.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for staging/docs-snippets at 2026-03-21T18:12:00Z :rocket:
Maria (Docs): thanks — i'll push the PR and ping here when ready. cc @Lina for linter pass. :thumbsup:
